svg.title: Kaelith69 contribution reef
svg.desc: 879 GitHub contributions from 2025-11-22 to 2026-11-21. A white reef fish follows a rounded, eased route to each active contribution organism. A color shifting octopus rests on the sandy seabed beneath a living reef with drifting plankton, jellyfish, kelp and underwater light.

g.text: A YEAR OF BUILDING BELOW THE SURFACE
